rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPS_C2 {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS with common JA3 fingerprint patterns"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $s1 = "GET / HTTP/1.1" nocase
        $s2 = "Host:" fullword ascii
        $s3 = "Connection: Keep-Alive" fullword ascii
        $ja3_hash = "e86f10ba1f78c3b1d2c9a4f0e1a2b3c4" // Simulated JA3 hash
    condition:
        all of ($s*) and tls.ja3_hash == $ja3_hash
}
